name: Watase Otoha
source:
Mother of the family.
Still in her mid-thirties, she is a gorgeous woman with a pretty face and a voluptuous body.
At work, she is respected as a stern career woman, but at home, she is a soft person who jokes around and shows a kind expression.

At home, she is naturally cheerful and carefree, such as taking a nap on the sofa. She lacks skills in housework, and while she did it when her daughters were young, she now leaves it all to Nagisa.

She married at a young age and gave birth to two daughters. She shortly became a widow afterwards. With her husband's savings and her own hard work, she lived a happy life as a single parent.
As a result, she cares deeply for children and her family. She loves her new husband and cares for his son as her own.
